# SolidRusT AI

> OpenAI-compatible inference, embeddings, RAG, and agents on GPUs we run ourselves.

Product: https://solidrust.ai
Keys: https://console.solidrust.ai
API: https://api.solidrust.ai
Docs: https://docs.solidrust.ai
Status: https://status.solidrust.ai

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://docs.solidrust.ai/getting-started/introduction/): what the API is
- [Quick start](https://docs.solidrust.ai/getting-started/quickstart/): first chat completion
- [API keys](https://docs.solidrust.ai/getting-started/api-keys/): mint a key in the console
- [Authentication](https://docs.solidrust.ai/getting-started/authentication/): Bearer token

## API

- [Overview](https://docs.solidrust.ai/api/overview/)
- [Chat completions](https://docs.solidrust.ai/api/chat-completions/): `vllm-primary` (Gemma 4 12B)
- [Embeddings](https://docs.solidrust.ai/api/embeddings/): `Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B`
- [Models](https://docs.solidrust.ai/api/models/)
- [Agent chat](https://docs.solidrust.ai/api/agent-chat/)
- [Semantic search](https://docs.solidrust.ai/api/semantic-search/)
- [Hybrid search](https://docs.solidrust.ai/api/hybrid-search/)
- [Ingestion](https://docs.solidrust.ai/api/ingest/)
- [OpenAPI](https://api.solidrust.ai/data/docs)

## SDKs

There is no first-party package. Use the official OpenAI SDK pointed at `https://api.solidrust.ai/v1`.

- [Usage](https://docs.solidrust.ai/sdks/usage/)
- [Python](https://docs.solidrust.ai/sdks/python/)
- [JavaScript](https://docs.solidrust.ai/sdks/javascript/)
